name: NASA Deep Space Station 23 operational addition at Goldstone
known_limitations: DSS-23 beginning mission communications on August 3 establishes an operational antenna milestone, not total network capacity, mission success, optical-communications readiness, or elimination of scheduling constraints.
automation_notes: Bind the operating claim to DSS-23, August 3, 2026, and the named mission-communication activity; do not generalize it to the whole network.
factual_nucleus: NASA describes DSS-23 as a new 34-meter antenna at Goldstone. After a May–July testing campaign, it began operations on August 3 tracking Chandra and subsequently communicated with missions including Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter, Psyche, Juno, and Voyager 1.
